statistics_policy: Sequential phases report request latency and a scoped duration, not throughput; tok/s and req/s are emitted only for a single concurrent burst.

vision_features.timing_definition: median over repeats of the maximum elapsed time across ranks
vision_features.scope: Vision-only; not end-to-end speedup or task-quality equivalence

partition_diagnosis.fp32_weight_source: loaded BF16 weights promoted to FP32
partition_diagnosis.boundary: The attention_projection hook observes its output, not its input. It does not identify a specific SDPA or cuBLAS algorithm as the cause.

parsing.rule: cut at first EOS, map first answer token 32..36 to A..E; other tokens unparseable

protocol.scope: vLLM internal TP/PP direction comparison, not an absolute Prism ranking

protocol.itl: observed client token intervals; coalesced tokens share one timestamp
protocol.e2e: immediately before generate to finished RequestOutput
protocol.cold: drain then reset prefix, encoder and multimodal processor caches
protocol.hot: same images, changed question, resident prefix and encoder caches
protocol.concurrent_cold: cold at burst start; reuse within the burst is allowed
protocol.throughput_scope: finite burst including prefill and drain, not saturation
protocol.pp_encoder: only first PP stage runs vision; data mode splits TP ranks, not PP stages

configured_kv_capacity.note: TP2 and PP2 shard the same logical KV; two TP1 engines duplicate this capacity
